title: As We Wait
edition: First edition of 500 copies (2015); second edition 2017

description.main: As We Wait collects 48 previously unpublished photographs by Andrea Modica, edited and sequenced by Larry Fink, who also wrote the introduction. Published by L'Artiere in 2015 as the first title in its collection, printed by Grafiche dell'Artiere in a first edition of 500 copies, with a second edition in 2017.
description.extended:
As We Wait is a 2015 monograph of 48 previously unpublished photographs by the American photographer Andrea Modica (b. 1960), edited and sequenced by Larry Fink and printed in Bologna by Grafiche dell'Artiere as the first title in the L'Artiere Collection.

The pictures come from several of Modica's recent projects and mix portraits, nudes, still lifes, landscapes and horses. All were made with an 8x10 view camera on Tri-X film and printed by the artist as platinum-palladium prints, reproduced here in three-colour printing. Fink, who also wrote the introduction, calls the work "not hopeless but breathless". The book appeared in a first edition of 500 copies alongside Modica's first Italian solo exhibition at Weber & Weber in Turin in November 2015, went to a second edition in 2017, and was selected for The Photobook Exhibition at the Benaki Museum, Athens.

Modica, a Yale MFA, Guggenheim Fellow and Fulbright Scholar, teaches at Drexel University in Philadelphia. Her earlier books include Minor League (Smithsonian, 1993), Treadwell (Chronicle, 1996), Human Being (Nazraeli, 2001) and Fountain (Stinehour, 2008). L'Artiere went on to publish her January 1, Catholic Girl and Italian Story. Her prints are held by MoMA, the Metropolitan Museum and the Whitney.
description.artist_bio: Andrea Modica (b. 1960, Brooklyn) holds a BFA from SUNY Purchase and an MFA from the Yale School of Art. Guggenheim Fellow, Fulbright Scholar, Knight Award recipient; teaches photography at Drexel University, Philadelphia. Works exclusively with an 8x10 camera on Tri-X and prints in platinum-palladium. Collections include MoMA, the Met, the Whitney, Brooklyn Museum, Philadelphia Museum of Art, ICP, SAAM, George Eastman Museum and the Bibliotheque nationale de France.
description.exhibition_context: Book launched with Modica's first Italian solo show, As We Wait, Weber & Weber Arte Moderna e Contemporanea, Turin, 7 November to 12 December 2015 (20+ platinum-palladium prints). Later selected for The Photobook Exhibition, Benaki Museum, Athens.
